title: Tampere Workers' Hall
scope: The historic cream-plaster Tampere Workers’ Hall on the corner of Hämeenpuisto and Hallituskatu, including the stepped tower, the lower hall wings and their courtyard.
limitations: Unpictured walls, smaller roof profiles, street fittings and unpublished section dimensions are approximate.
Model scope covers the protected hall and courtyard. The adjoining Workers’ Theatre and interior museum exhibits are outside the model scope.
